title: StorSafe Instance
description: Everything about one appliance. Pick the server at the top.

panels.title: Collected
panels.description: Time since this appliance was last collected.

panels.title: Days until full (30d trend)
panels.description: Free space divided by the 30-day growth rate. Shows a very large number while usage is flat or falling; needs several days of data to settle.

panels.title: Reclamation / prune
panels.description: Status from the API (idle/running/failed). Times are tracked by the collector, to one collector interval.

panels.title: Newest replica age
panels.description: Time since the most recently updated replica tape held here.

panels.title: Recent warnings, errors and criticals
panels.description: The 20 newest non-informational events. The full log is archived daily under events\ on the monitoring host.

panels.title: Package version
panels.description: Version of the installed StorSafe monitoring package (VERSION file in the install folder).
